chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Hi everyone and welcome to PNK College. Today we will discuss in detail about the differences between data science, data analytics and data engineering.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Whenever we start exploring the field of data science, we get to hear different names.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: But because we don't know the exact meaning of these professions or domains, we get confused.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So in today's session, we will be exploring in detail what are the differences between a data scientist, a data analyst and a data engineer.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We will discuss the profession that we should choose and what skills we should have before we start applying for a job.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And what kind of work we should actually do in the field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Before we talk about the fields, we should know some basic terms.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: For example, we have heard AI, machine learning, deep learning, all these terms are related to data science or in fact, in general.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So first of all, we will talk about their differences.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Let's start with AI. The broadest term, the major term that we get to hear is AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: When we talk about AI, it's a very broad term.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: AI means when we teach our machines to think on their own and to take decisions on their own.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: For example, today we have seen a lot of practical implementations of AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Like chat, GPT, mid journey and Dali.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Or we have seen the recommendation engine of Netflix.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That according to the movie we are watching, which movie should we watch next?

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Or our self-driving cars, our voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, Google.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: All these are real-life implementations of artificial intelligence.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And artificial intelligence has another sub-domain, which we call machine learning.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: All machine learning, that is, all ML, is all AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Yes, there can be some AI that is not ML based.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Like our rule-based AI is not machine learning, but it is still part of AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now when we talk about machine learning, ML is the subset of AI in which we use data and put a lot of sophisticated algorithms on it to make productions.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: The maximum of all the AI we see in today's data is implemented using machine learning techniques.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now if we want to study machine learning in detail, it has three sub-types.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Supervised learning, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Supervised learning is the type of machine learning in which we have a lot of data, all that is labeled data.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, we know what output should come according to which input.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: For example, if we are building a system for spam filtering in emails,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then we already have such data in which we have a lot of emails and we also have an output that which email is spam and which is not spam.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So here we will use supervised learning to find out how many percent of the email in the future is spam and how many emails are genuine.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: The second category is unsupervised learning in which we have output unknown.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: In this, we generally solve clustering or associative problems.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And the third type is reinforcement learning in which we generally have some data labeled and some data unlabeled.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Reinforcement learning has a very good implementation.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We have recommendation systems, that is, what kind of content we should see in the future based on what we saw in the old content.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now this is machine learning. Machine learning has a subset which we call deep learning.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Basically, we talk about neural networks in deep learning.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Neural networks mean that we are trying to build this type of machine learning algorithms in deep learning that can mimic our human brain.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Our human brain works on neural networks and when we apply layers of many networks in this way,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then that network becomes very deep and from here we get the concept of deep learning.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Deep learning has different categories of neural networks that we are studying.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Like ANN, our artificial neural network, CNN, convolutional neural networks or RNN, recurrent neural networks.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So, in a way, we can say that deep learning is all about complex neural networks.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And then there is another subset of deep learning which we call generative AI or in short, GEN AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Today we have used chat GPT, we have seen software like Dali, we have seen mid journey.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: All these are the parts of generative AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We call the complex branch of deep learning as generative AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Generative AI is the AI that can generate new content, creative content.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Generative AI can generate new text, new audio, new videos, new images.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And this is basically the creative part of AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, this is artistic AI that will generate things that perhaps no one has ever generated before.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And that is why it is very sophisticated.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now, I would like to give a small disclaimer to the beginners here that many times we get to see such tutorials on the internet

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: that in one hour, in two hours, in two and a half hours we will master chat GPT.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We will become masters of AI, so we should not get caught up in such things.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Chat GPT or in fact generative AI is quite sophisticated AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Generally, those who work on chat GPT or generative AI are very good in their field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And many of them have spent at least 10-15 years in this field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Many people even have a PhD.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We cannot match that knowledge in a 2-2.5 hour tutorial.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So we should have this knowledge as a beginner that using chat GPT and building chat GPT is a big difference.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now, this is all about AI machine learning, deep learning and generative AI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now, how does data science fit in here?

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Data science is basically all of this and plus something extra.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, data science is even bigger than this, if we look at it in a way.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Because the data scientist inside it works on machine learning, deep learning, generative AI or any normal AI problem.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That means he knows these things.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Plus, what does he know? Plus, he has a good command on mathematical tools.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Mathematical tools are the concepts of our deep maths.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Like statistics, probability, linear algebra, calculus.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: He has a strong command on all of these concepts.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And he has a good knowledge of different tools.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So if we want to go into the field of data science, then in that case, our machine learning should be strong.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Along with that, our maths concepts should also be strong because that is what the field demands.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So now that we have an idea of basic terms, let's know the difference between data science, data engineer and data analytics.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Generally, our entire pipeline is that we bring raw data from somewhere.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We convert it into good data.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Then we did some analysis on it.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: After that, we built a machine learning model on it.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And then we got some good results from there, which we applied to our business.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: If we divide this entire process into four steps, then the first step will be the one in which we collect the data and store it.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So this work is generally done by our data engineers.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Data engineers have a major responsibility to build a good, stable, scalable infrastructure.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Because of which, data analytics or data scientists should be able to get it easily available.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And it may sound easy to hear that collect and store data, but it is actually a very complex thing to do.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So these data engineers are software engineers.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, they have a good programming language like Java or C++.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: It has a strong base, plus they also know how to work on big data.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So to become a data engineer, we should have all these skillsets.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: After that comes our second and third step.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: One more thing, these steps can overlap many times.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, it is possible that one company has only this much work as a data engineer.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Plus, it can be done in any other company.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: The data engineer does the first step and also does some parts in the second step.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So we come to the second step, which is data cleaning and transformation.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So our second step is to clean this data and then analyze it, label it.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: The second and third step is generally the work of data analysts.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: They look at the data and get some useful insights from it.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And then how can those insights, that is, the useful information be used to grow a business?

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: They are working on that thing.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So to become a data analyst, we should have the experience of visualization tools.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Like Tableau or Power BI.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Along with that, we should have good communication skills in our field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Because we have taken out insights from the data many times.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: They must be presenting to other people and explaining them.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And along with that, if you have basic math or basic programming language like Python,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: if you have knowledge, then that is considered a big plus.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now this role is generally put in the category of non-technical.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Because in many companies, data analysts are not coding.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Whereas some companies are such that data analysts are coding a little bit.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: But generally, there is not much coding in this role.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So to become a data analyst, we should have all these skillsets.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And finally, the fourth step is to do prediction modeling on data.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, if we have good data, good clean data, labeled data,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then what will we do on that?

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We will build machine learning models on that.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: We will apply machine learning algorithms.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: By using that data, we will be building good models that can be used in the company in the future.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So all this work in which machine learning algorithms are being applied,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: this work is done by a data scientist.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Apart from this, there are some additional things like AB testing.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So the testing of this type is also done by our data scientists.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So let's summarize once.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Generally, this role is of our data engineers.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: This role is of our data analysts.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And this role is of our data scientists.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now I will give you one more disclaimer here.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: These terms are used in different companies in different ways.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: That is, it is possible that in a startup, a data scientist who wants to hire a startup,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: they are giving him the name data scientist, but they are getting all the work done by him.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: This is also possible.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So generally, if we observe, there can be many startups in which if there is a small team of data science,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then it is possible that the data scientist has a lot of different work that he is doing himself,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: which may not be part of their domain.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And on the other hand, in big companies, if there are a lot of people,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then generally, a clear segregation is seen that which person's role is of a data engineer,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: which person's role is of a data analyst, and which person's role is of a data scientist.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now if we talk about the data science industry,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then generally, all the big packages that we get to hear,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: that majority is given to data scientists.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So data scientists earn the most in data science because they have the most specialized skillset.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: After that, the second number is earning wise, that is, general earning wise, our data engineers come,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: and after that comes our data analysts.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now as a fresher, when the majority of companies hire for placement in the data science field,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then they hire data analysts, who do not have much of a coding role in them.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So if you are a student who is a fresher who is not very interested in coding,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then you can target the field of data analytics.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Or if you are a student who is interested in coding,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: but specifically not very interested in machine learning,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then you can target the field of data engineering,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: if we want to go specifically into the domain of data science.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: There are many software engineers who work in software engineering first in companies,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: and after that, they use big data and shift to the data engineering field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And if you are somebody who is very interested in machine learning algorithms,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: machine learning models, then you should target data science as a field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Now here is another thing that in the industry,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: if a company has a lot of complex data science work,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then many times companies prefer that the data scientist they are hiring,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: they have at least a PhD degree.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: So that's why if we want to become a data scientist,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: then either our dedication should be very high in the field,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: and with time we can gain a lot of experience.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Or we should also think that I have to go ahead and target masters or PhDs in this field.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: Additionally, in the data science field, it is also possible to shift your domain.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: It is possible that you start as a data analyst,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: but after that you start learning coding,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: you start gaining more experience,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: and slowly you shift to a data engineering domain.

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: And after that, it is possible that you are doing masters,

chunks.video_title: data analyst vs scientist vs engineer
chunks.text: or you are taking more experience,

chunks.text: you are taking machine learning experience,

chunks.text: you are building projects on your side.

chunks.text: Now the packages in data science vary a lot.

chunks.text: Packages also depend on how many years of experience you have,

chunks.text: they also depend on which company you are applying to,
